title: A new job, made reliable
subtitle: Private draft 2: first case only, silent with captions, 20 October 2026
notes: Draft 2 of the reliability cut's first case, from draft 1 (reliability-first-case-2026-10-20.json at 82222f9, rendered as first-case-draft-1, kept unchanged) with the review's two presentation repairs: the failure beat's narration now opens with the hand knocking the bowl off, so that caption is on screen while the bowl falls; the check is shown as a card with a plain summary, labelled as a summary, instead of the check's technical purpose text. The frames leave run ids and digests out (sources_on_screen viewer); provenance.json keeps them. Same footage, records and bindings as draft 1. Reliability cut, first case (robots-qzfk.44.5), a private silent draft. The first reliable agent job, replacement-01: bowl on the cabinet top and middle drawer open, no order rule; released 20 of 20 on reserved starts 30 to 49 against 1 of 20 for the plain chain, 19 rescued, 0 broken (receipt, reconciled in coordinator-verification.json). Arc: request, visible failure, the agent's discriminating experiment, working procedure, what the library keeps. Clips: the plain chain's failure and the release pair are the first rescued reserved start (initial state 31), chosen by `python -m fleetlab.film pairs` (plain chain e000202, saved job e000102), shown as verified 720px re-renders (all 1,298 state hashes and both final verdicts matched); the experiment pair is practice start 2 of session 3 (open-then-home j0005 e000503 against placement-runs-on-then-home j0006 e000603), original 360px recordings at a frame every fourth control step. Numbers on cards come from the bound script (site/reliability/script.md, fields site/reliability/fields.json, records reliability-first-case-2026-10-20.records.json); the request excerpt on screen is the first two sentences of job_run.json request.request_text, verbatim. The second job is pending: its slot is a comment in the script and r2_* fields in fields.json, and nothing of it is shown. No new run; nothing re-shot; no host-screen footage or result. The wrist re-render of e000202 is not used: its replay report names the scene original as original_video, so the film's verification refuses it for the wrist camera; the failure is shown in the scene view only.
